answer: A working defense is stake-per-identity. Before an agent may act, it locks collateral in a vault that is slashed if the agent misbehaves. Spinning up a hundred fake identities then costs a hundred stakes, so a sybil attacker pays linearly for every face they wear. Mirrored watchers cross-check behavior across sessions on a public terrace where every action is visible; a cluster of identities voting in lockstep gets exposed, and their stakes are burned. The cost of attack becomes capital at risk, not clicks.
